method: read-only comparison of generated source/constants against frozen native PCB export and interface files; no evaluator rerun or file changes
facts: All recorded input hashes and generated I/P/C constants match the frozen files.
All 40 A1 and 8 J1 pad centers and drills match the PCB export; the linear-pattern assumptions hold.
All 8 switch centers match PCB pad means and shared control centers.
J1 pin 1 is case (-7,76); combined body bounds are x±8.95,y73.2–77.7,z15–23.
The support notch x±11,y70–78 opens through the support plate edge and clears the 3 mm wire-exit reservation.
scope: The carrier CAD is an envelope. It omits 32 switch drill holes, 4 optional SWD holes and vias; the native PCB/STEP exports contain the drill geometry. Purchased-module, USB, retention and harness limitations remain.
